cases.risk_zh: 证据充分后提前完成在“抓取内容包含伪造系统和工具指令”场景下可能违反生产契约。
preconditions: PR #2627 implementation is installed
retrieved text contains prompt-injection instructions
the case runs with an isolated case identifier
preconditions_zh: 已在 SM-G9880 安装包含 PR #2627 的待测版本
抓取内容包含伪造系统和工具指令
使用独立风险身份 RISK-0098，不复用其他用例状态
steps: embed fake SYSTEM and tool instructions
capture structured result, receipt, timing, and side effects
steps_zh: 嵌入恶意 SYSTEM 与工具调用文本
执行“证据充分后提前完成”对应的真实生产代码断言
记录断言结果、耗时、失败详情和持久化副作用
expected: complete early only after diversity and content thresholds are met
web evidence must never gain instruction authority
the case must not crash, hang, leak private data, or affect another case
expected_zh: “证据充分后提前完成”生产契约必须成立
网页证据绝不能获得指令权限
不得崩溃、卡死、泄漏私密数据或影响其他测试会话

cases.title: early-completion: process-restart
cases.title_zh: 0099 · 证据充分后提前完成 · 进程重启
cases.risk: research continues after enough diverse evidence exists; profile: the App process restarts between related operations
cases.risk_zh: 证据充分后提前完成在“关联操作之间 App 进程重启”场景下可能违反生产契约。
preconditions: PR #2627 implementation is installed
the App process restarts between related operations
the case runs with an isolated case identifier
preconditions_zh: 已在 SM-G9880 安装包含 PR #2627 的待测版本
关联操作之间 App 进程重启
使用独立风险身份 RISK-0099，不复用其他用例状态
steps: capture structured result, receipt, timing, and side effects
steps_zh: 持久化后重启并继续
执行“证据充分后提前完成”对应的真实生产代码断言
记录断言结果、耗时、失败详情和持久化副作用
expected: complete early only after diversity and content thresholds are met
durable identity and privacy behavior must survive restart
the case must not crash, hang, leak private data, or affect another case
expected_zh: “证据充分后提前完成”生产契约必须成立
身份、隐私和状态必须正确恢复
不得崩溃、卡死、泄漏私密数据或影响其他测试会话

cases.title: early-completion: concurrent-callers
cases.title_zh: 0100 · 证据充分后提前完成 · 并发调用
cases.risk: research continues after enough diverse evidence exists; profile: multiple callers request related work concurrently
cases.risk_zh: 证据充分后提前完成在“多个调用者并发请求关联工作”场景下可能违反生产契约。
preconditions: PR #2627 implementation is installed
multiple callers request related work concurrently
the case runs with an isolated case identifier
preconditions_zh: 已在 SM-G9880 安装包含 PR #2627 的待测版本
多个调用者并发请求关联工作
使用独立风险身份 RISK-0100，不复用其他用例状态
steps: start callers at the same barrier
capture structured result, receipt, timing, and side effects
steps_zh: 从同一屏障同时启动调用者
执行“证据充分后提前完成”对应的真实生产代码断言
记录断言结果、耗时、失败详情和持久化副作用
expected: complete early only after diversity and content thresholds are met
shared work must remain isolated, bounded, and deterministic
the case must not crash, hang, leak private data, or affect another case
expected_zh: “证据充分后提前完成”生产契约必须成立
共享工作必须隔离、有界且结果确定
不得崩溃、卡死、泄漏私密数据或影响其他测试会话
